<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/intro-dark.svg"><img src="assets/intro-light.svg" alt="Hi, I'm Maarib. Product designer at heart, where product keeps flipping to founding, graphic, web, digital, lead, full-stack, motion, cat-approved and front-end." width="100%"></picture>

Based in Toronto, I'm currently a Lead Product Designer @ <picture><img src="desk/data/logos/rbc.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> RBC Wealth Management, making self-directed investing approachable for everyone. Over the past several years, I've been leading design for both traditional and on-chain financial products. I work end-to-end, from defining the problem to designing the experience and getting it to a production-ready(ish) state.

## 🛠️ Workflow

I start with too many tabs open and a long chat with Claude. Discovery, IA and user flows happen in <picture><img src="assets/stack/figma.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Figma. Prototypes happen in <picture><img src="assets/stack/vs-code.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> VS Code with <picture><img src="assets/stack/claude-code.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Claude Code and <picture><img src="assets/stack/vite.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Vite, because I'd rather click it than imagine it. Tokens live in <picture><img src="assets/stack/tokens-studio.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Tokens Studio, <picture><img src="assets/stack/style-dictionary.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Style Dictionary turns them into code, and the <picture><img src="assets/stack/react.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> React components get their docs in <picture><img src="assets/stack/storybook.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Storybook. It all ships to <picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/stack/vercel-dark.svg"><img src="assets/stack/vercel.svg" height="16" align="absmiddle" alt=""></picture> Vercel, so feedback happens on a real link.
